generated_query: I run a small e-commerce business selling handmade candles. I get orders through both my website (Shopify) and Etsy. I want to automate the order fulfillment process: when a new order comes in from either platform, automatically create a packing slip in Google Sheets, send a confirmation email to the customer, and notify my shipping team via Slack. Also, if the order value is over $100, I need to add a free gift SKU to the order in my inventory system. Can you help me design this workflow using no-code tools like Zapier or Make?

edit_instructions.rationale: Without the execution step, the skill cannot guide building the actual automation workflow, leaving the user's implementation incomplete.
